lists.name: Pitchfork: The 200 Best Albums of the 2010s

podcast.body: This album was selected as the Album of the Year by The Daily Bad Camp, a publication known for good lists. It was also previously mentioned in a list of the 15 most interesting albums released in 2017. The album is described as fantastic and truly fantastic, with its style difficult to categorize, but it stands out as one of the best releases of the year. "un disco fantástico, verdaderamente fantástico."

srcs.episode: El Disco del Año 2017: Según cada publicación

podcast.body: This is a fantastic album, variously categorized as soul, electronic, pop, or downtempo. It is a debut album from a very young artist, merely twenty-six years old, yet it displays an incredible level of stylistic influences. The album features truly intimate, deep, and personal lyrics for such a young individual, subtly incorporating a multitude of influences. Despite its many influences, the record sounds very clean, pure, and calm, making it a small diamond. "además es increíble ser el Almond de Wood de un chaval jovencísimo apenas si no veintiséis años y es increíble el nivel de influencias estilísticas que puede llegar a tener un disco verdaderamente intimista con letras verdaderamente profundas y personales para una persona tan joven que además incorpora un montón de influencias de una manera completamente sutile en disco a pesar de tener tantísimas influencias una muy limpio, suena muy puro, suena muy tranquilo que es como lo hace como un pequeño diamante."
